domains.name: Human Capability, Cognitive Readiness & AI-Ready Education

executiveSummary.headline: Clear strategic intent; institutional response capacity and its evidence lag behind.
executiveSummary.narrative: Across the three assessed domains, Demonstration University articulates AI as a strategic priority with senior ownership. The governance mechanisms, human capability development and documentary evidence that would carry that intent through the institution are less developed. The largest distance between current and required maturity is in governance and responsible AI; the least-evidenced position is in human capability, where several claims remain unvalidated pending evidence.

keyStrengths.title: Articulated strategic intent
keyStrengths.body: AI is named within the current strategic plan with senior ownership, providing a mandate other areas can draw on.

keyStrengths.title: Published academic integrity guidance
keyStrengths.body: Institution-wide guidance on generative AI in assessment exists and is publicly accessible.

keyStrengths.title: A defined home for AI questions
keyStrengths.body: A cross-institutional AI working group with terms of reference gives AI-related questions an identifiable owner.

priorityGaps.title: Governance depends on a single working group
priorityGaps.body: Institutional response to consequential AI questions routes through one advisory group without a defined decision right or escalation pathway.

priorityGaps.title: Capability development is largely self-directed
priorityGaps.body: Development opportunities exist but are optional and uneven; no institution-wide capability baseline is in place.

priorityGaps.title: Response claims are thinly evidenced
priorityGaps.body: Claims about how the institution responds to new AI questions are not yet supported by documented decision or review records.

overall.withheldReason: An overall ARUI /100 figure is not reported at partial coverage (3 of 11 domains). The presentation rule for partial-scope results is a pending methodology decision (MD-08).
overall.narrative: Domain positions are shown individually. Transformation distance is the gap between the maturity the institution's context requires and the maturity currently demonstrated; it is diagnostic and is not a penalty.

paragraphs: The AI Resilient University Index assesses institutional AI resilience across eleven domains and 143 metrics. Each metric is scored by trained assessors against domain-specific maturity anchors on three constructs: maturity (how developed the capability is), implementation depth (how far it operates in practice) and outcome (what it has produced), together with an evidence level.

Required maturity is derived from the institution's context — mandate, AI exposure, disciplinary consequence and trajectory — and expresses the maturity the institution's situation reasonably calls for. Context never adds or removes points from a capability score. Transformation distance is the difference between required and current maturity and is diagnostic.
Evidence confidence is reported separately from capability and never multiplies a score. Cross-domain findings are diagnostic signals that guide verification and never adjust a position.
scoringSummary: Capability positions are assessor-scored, not computed from questionnaire answers.
Domain positions average the applicable metric scores; not-applicable metrics are excluded only where inapplicability was documented and accepted.
Unknown, not sure, not answered and not applicable are recorded as distinct states; none of them is treated as zero.

maturityScale.label: Reactive
maturityScale.meaning: Capability appears only in response to events.

maturityScale.label: Emerging
maturityScale.meaning: Capability is forming in parts of the institution.

maturityScale.label: Structured
maturityScale.meaning: Capability is defined, owned and repeatable.

maturityScale.label: Integrated
maturityScale.meaning: Capability operates across the institution and connects to other capabilities.

maturityScale.label: Adaptive
maturityScale.meaning: Capability learns and changes ahead of events.

limitations: This is a Preliminary ARUI Assessment covering 3 of 11 domains (D01–D03). Positions for D04–D11 are not assessed and no indicative score is given for them.
Preliminary results are not a certification. Independent verification is a separate, later process and has not started.
Evidence confidence bands and an overall ARUI /100 figure at partial coverage await methodology decisions and are therefore not reported.
Several positions, particularly in D03, rest on self-declared evidence and may change materially once requested evidence is supplied.
The methodology version used is pre-pilot. Public benchmark status is blocked and the assessment is not a ranking.

reassessment.recommendedWindow: Re-read the D03 position on receipt of outstanding evidence; full reassessment of D01–D03 in 12–18 months or on a material governance change.
